endpoint_review.method: All main scenes inspected in native-size paired crop contacts; representative full figures and dense/problem details inspected separately. Contacts preserve native text pixels. Screenshot generation alone is not this review.

motion_review.method: Real Sequence/Case/Next/Pause controls; previous committed snapshot retained during a nontrivial transition, then paused after requested 40% of 900 ms. Observed animation times are recorded per frame. Full figure height expanded before starting to keep all objects visible; native scene crops inspected for every frame.
motion_review.selection_coverage: Every listed selection in all four profiles; ring adds a separate gather copy and GPUDirect adds its direct-path case.

findings.subject: Short lanes and dense ready pools
findings.observation: Traditional and overlap lanes use keyed legends for short bars. Axis endpoints, event keys, full ring contributors, GPU owners, retained values, and Ready text remain readable in narrow and desktop light/dark scenes.

findings.subject: Causal teaching flow
findings.observation: Retry retains independent outputs; staged/direct transfers preserve source identity; PAUSE clearance precedes packet forwarding; prepared batches wait for dispatch; immutable checkpoint generation remains separate from live weight and restore pointer; backward/network overlap precedes optimizer update; hierarchical and ring reductions retain partial contributors until full results become ready.

findings.subject: Duplicate incoming carrier overlap
findings.observation: Small generic Update carrier badges can overlap duplicate Incoming strings during checkpoint/ring reduction and wrap on narrow execution cells. Original values, owners, and committed contributor sets remain readable; endpoints are clean. Accepted under the advanced review allowance for duplicate arrival text.

shared_controls_reference.scope: Shared keyboard, play/pause, restart, speed, reduced-motion and control regressions are covered by the referenced report with its own stated surface and limits; this review does not duplicate or broaden that claim.

limits: Expert visual and technical review, not testing with real students.
Endpoint coverage is exhaustive for this author file; motion coverage samples representative nontrivial transitions and shared primitives, not every transition at every time.
Native contacts inspect main scenes; full screenshots include surrounding chapter/control context.
This acceptance is bound to the stated actual HTML build and runtime/source hashes; PDF/EPUB preservation is outside this visual report.
